Chilling: Several hours
Baking: 10 to 12 minutes | difficulty = 3 | Image = [[File:Chocolate Crinkles.jpg|300px]] }} {{recipe}} These '''chocolate crinkles''' are easy to make, but do require chilling the dough for several hours before forming into cookies and baking. They have a strong chocolate taste and a dramatic black and white appearance. One recipe makes 3 to 4 dozen cookies. == Ingredients == * ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]] * 4 squares (4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 115 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[cookbook:Unsweetened chocolate|unsweetened chocolate]], melted * 2 cups (480 ml) white [[cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]] * 4 [[cookbook:egg|eggs]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] (10 ml) [[cookbook:Vanilla Extract|vanilla extract]] * 2 cups (480 ml) [[cookbook:Flour|all purpose flour]] * 2 tsp (10 ml) [[cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]] * ½ tsp (2.5 ml) [[cookbook:salt|salt]] * 1 cup (240 ml) [[cookbook:Confectioners' Sugar|confectioners' sugar]] == Procedure == # Mix oil, chocolate, and granulated sugar. # Blend in one egg at a time until well mixed. Add vanilla. # Stir flour, baking powder, and salt into chocolate mixture. # Chill several hours or overnight. # Heat oven to 350°[[Cookbook:F|F]] (175°C). # Drop teaspoonfuls of dough into confectioners' sugar. # Roll in sugar; shape into balls. # Place about 2 inches (5 cm) apart on greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]]. # Bake 10 to 12 minutes. == Visual procedure == File:Melting Chocolate in Double Boiler.jpg|Melting chocolate in double boiler File:Chocolate Crinkles - Add oil and sugar to chocolate.jpg|Adding sugar File:Chocolate Crinkles - Mix chocolate, sugar, and oil.jpg|Mixing in sugar File:Chocolate Crinkles - Mix in eggs.jpg|Mixing in eggs File:Chocolate Crinkles - Mix in vanilla extract.jpg|Mixing in vanilla File:Chocolate Crinkles - sift in flour, salt, baking powder.jpg|Adding dry ingredients File:Chocolate Crinkles - Mix in dry ingredients.jpg|Mixing in dry File:Chocolate Crinkles - After chilling, prep powdered sugar and cookie sheet.jpg|Prep for forming cookies File:Chocolate Crinkles - Dough ball in powdered Sugar.jpg|Rolling cookies in powdered sugar File:Chocolate Crinkles - Place balls on baking sheet 2 in apart.jpg| Placing cookies on baking sheet File:Chocolate Crinkles - Put baking sheet in oven.jpg|Baking cookies File:Chocolate Crinkles - Remove after baking at 350F.jpg| Finished cookies [[Category:Recipes using unsweetened chocolate]] [[Category:Recipes for cookies]] [[Category:Baking recipes]] [[Category:Recipes with metric units]] [[Category:Recipes with images]] [[Category:Featured recipe candidates]] [[Category:Kid-friendly recipes]] [[Category:Recipes using egg]] [[Category:Recipes for dessert]] [[Category:Recipes using baking powder]] [[Category:Recipes using white sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using powdered sugar]] [[Category:Recipes using all-purpose flour]] [[Category:Recipes using vegetable oil]]
